transcription: The pinned assignment-only AES Verilog is parsed mechanically. Every source signal is represented by complementary rails, the listed Boolean identities are applied gate by gate, and only the positive output rails are exposed. The 2738/10/3 metrics are independently recomputed properties of this repository-derived lowering, not metrics reported by Jia et al.
